content: Researcher in Bibliometrics, Science of Science & Social Network Analysis
Hello! I am Danho Kim, an academic researcher specializing in Bibliometrics, Science of Science, and Social Network Analysis (SNA).
My research investigates the structural and social dynamics of knowledge production, scholarly collaboration networks, and institutional spaces. Specifically, my work focuses on:

title: Structural Holes & Collaboration Networks
content: Exploring how brokering positions across disciplinary boundaries influence research performance and field maturation.

title: Author Embeddedness & Bibliographic Coupling
content: Analyzing author-level subject embeddedness and thematic evolution in scientific communities.

title: Library Place-Shaping & User Perception
content: Phenomenological and empirical investigations into how academic libraries function as socially constructed spaces.
I combine Social Network Analysis (SNA), Classical Statistics, and In-depth Qualitative Inquiry to bridge quantitative graph metrics with rich contextual interpretations.
